verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers trade mark registration, patent filing (One Login and paper forms), search, renewal and licensing. Nothing in it describes third-party representatives or agents, authorization forms, delegated roles, or which signatures must stay personal to the owner. An IP office could plausibly publish such rules, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence for it here.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
